column1: Solution: to ensure battery health, do not power off the aircraft until discharging it to 5% after landing. Restart and sync the flight data. Contact DJI Support as soon as possible.

column1: Complete battery discharging and charging is required. Otherwise, flight safety may be affected due to inaccurate power detection. .

column1: Discharge battery to 5% or below after flight. Charge battery to 50% for long-term storage.
column2: Sau khi bay, xả pin xuống 5% hoặc thấp hơn. Sạc tới 50% nếu cất giữ lâu dài.

column1: Check Aircraft Load. Heavy loads may lead to overcurrent. Reduce excessive motion during flight.

column1: Stop flying, cool battery to room temperature and retry.
